issue: Spec exports `StepResult(label, success, message="", archive=None, skipped=False)`, so `skipped` can be passed positionally. The implementation makes `skipped` keyword-only (`*, skipped`), so a fifth positional argument raises TypeError.
The YAML example uses unquoted `source: ~`, which YAML parses as null, leaving no source configured. Quote it as `source: "~"`.

The spec says to normalize with `posixpath.normpath`. The code uses `os.path.normpath`, which is identical on POSIX but differs on Windows.
A present non-regular item (fifo, socket, device) is silently ignored, neither archived nor reported. If it is the only item, the step becomes a skip.

`_plan_items` short-circuits after the first present item, hiding access errors in later items. Thus `["present.txt", "locked/inner.txt"]` plans as `run`, while reversing the items produces `fail`.
